newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Great Lakes estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Great Lakes estimates cut.

text.p: - EVEREN Securities analyst Timothy Gerdeman said he reduced his earnings estimates for Great Lakes Chemical Corp based on the impact on revenues and profits of weak demand of some specialty chemicals.

- Gerdeman said he lowered his 1996 third quarter earnings estimate to $1.10 a share from $1.20. He also trimmed his 1996 year estimate to $4.40 from $4.58 and his 1997 year estimate to $4.70 from $5.00.
- Shares of Great Lakes were trading off 1/8 to 53-3/4.
